results.name: DP-01 account-free: no login / auth route answers, no auth library or sign-in call in the client bundle
DP-02 no ads, feeds or upsells: zero ad/promo/upsell components or strings in src/, zero ad-SDK markers in the client bundle
RG-03 idle: with the desktop static for 3 s, zero requestAnimationFrame callbacks run (rAF counted by an init script)
RG-07 capability report: ≥ 40 APIs in Settings → Capabilities, each row has detail/degrade text, sampled rows equal independent detection
SC-03 permission audit: Settings lists every name of the full permission list, each state equals an independent permissions.query
AX-04 focus not obscured: Tab into a control of a covered window raises that window (server focus + top z); programmatic focus does not
